title: fix: correct Ask Polli authorization heredoc
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes the authorization shell failure in `!askpolli` by aligning the heredoc delimiter.
- Adds real Bash syntax and authorization execution checks for both `!askpolli` and `!polli`.
- Preserves whitelist-first gating and existing permissions.

gist.headline: Polli Gets Past The Gate
gist.blurb: A crooked heredoc line had Polli arguing with the shell instead of answering questions. The authorization gate is aligned again, so the little bee can get back to useful buzzing.
gist.summary: Fixed the `!askpolli` GitHub workflow authorization shell failure by aligning its heredoc delimiter, and added Bash syntax plus authorization execution checks for both `!askpolli` and `!polli` while retaining whitelist-first permissions.
gist.impact: Contributors using `!askpolli` and `!polli` can once again pass the existing authorization flow reliably, with automated checks guarding the shell syntax and permission gate.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a helpful GitHub workflow gardener at a cozy garden gate: a properly aligned glowing scroll/heredoc lets her through a whitelist-first checkpoint, while a retro terminal shows clean green check marks. The gate and code-plants represent authorization and shell validation; Polli should look calmly pleased at the formerly fussy shell behaving itself.
